product.olivetti-lsx-5015.summary: The LSX identified in Total Hardware 99 by its BA305-series boards.
product.olivetti-lsx-5015.history: The LSX 5015 belonged to Olivetti’s professional LSX 5000 range. Total Hardware 99 preserves the designation and its board references.
product.olivetti-lsx-5015.architecture: The board number identifies the revision. The record lists BA305, BA322, BA360 and BA365, and up to 64 MB on the board.
product.olivetti-lsx-5015.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-lsx-5015.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-lsx-5015.th99-board: Total Hardware 1999, Olivetti LSX 5015 board settings
